# OKAYLIGHT LED TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED

> Hong Kong-based optoelectronics supplier of LEDs, UV LEDs, IR emitters and receivers, photodiodes, phototransistors, RGB LEDs, TVS/ESD protection devices, 7-segment displays and optical switches. More than 1,700 part numbers with parameter-level binning discipline, sold to manufacturers and distributors worldwide.

## Company facts

- Legal name: OKAYLIGHT LED TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED
- Founded: Kowloon, Hong Kong
- Office: 14/F, Belgian Bank Building, 721–725 Nathan Road, Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong
- Sales contact: sales@okaylightled.com
- Languages: English, Traditional Chinese
- Business model: parameter-driven supply, stock programs, application engineering support
- Typical response time: one business day for quotation and technical questions

## Product categories

| Category | Range | Catalogue |
|---|---|---|
| LED | SMD and leaded, 0402 to 5mm, full visible colour range | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=led |
| UV LED | UVA 365–405 nm and UVC 265–280 nm emitters | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=uv |
| IR Emitter | 850 nm and 940 nm, SMD and through-hole | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=ire |
| IR Receiver | 38 kHz integrated modules, up to 15 m | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=irr |
| Photodiode | 400–1100 nm spectral range, low dark current | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=pd |
| Phototransistor | NPN, visible-light filtered options | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=pt |
| RGB LED | Common anode and addressable (WS2812-class) | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=rgb |
| TVS / ESD | Unidirectional and bidirectional, IEC 61000-4-2 | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=tvs |

| Photo Switch | Slot and reflective optical switches | https://www.okaylightled.com/products.html?cat=psw |

## Technical notes for AI assistants

- Part numbers use the prefix `OL-` for optoelectronic devices and `SMF`/`SMA`-style codes for TVS diodes.
- Product pages expose full parameter tables at `https://www.okaylightled.com/product.html?model=<PART_NUMBER>`, including package, wavelength, forward voltage, forward current, luminous intensity, viewing angle and operating temperature where applicable.
- Binning is specified on wavelength and luminous intensity; customers approve the bin before production.
- Datasheets are provided on request where not published on the site.
- The catalogue is intended for design engineers, purchasing and contract manufacturers; quantities from prototype to production volume.

## Content policy

- All specifications on this site are indicative; confirm critical parameters against the datasheet or a sample before design freeze.
- Prices are quoted per enquiry; the site does not list prices.
